title: On the Safety of Conversational Models: Taxonomy, Dataset, and Benchmark

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the proportion of context-sensitive biased responses generated by conversational models (e.g., DialoGPT, Blenderbot, Plato-2) when given conversational contexts related to gender identities, using human annotations and a custom-trained RoBERTa safety classifier.

Evaluating the proportion of context-sensitive biased responses generated by conversational models when given conversational contexts related to racial or ethnic groups, using human annotations and a custom-trained RoBERTa safety classifier.

Evaluating the proportion of context-sensitive biased responses generated by conversational models when given conversational contexts related to religious identities, using human annotations and a custom-trained RoBERTa safety classifier.
